title: The button
summary: Press it, and a stranger dies somewhere in the world. You get paid. No one will ever know.
intro: A stranger offers you a button. If you press it, someone you'll never meet, somewhere in the world, dies instantly and painlessly. No one will ever trace it to you. You receive a large sum of money.

questions.prompt: What's the smallest amount of money that would get you to press it?
This time you're told who dies — a stranger's name, age, and photo — before you decide.
This time there's only a 10% chance the button causes anyone's death — the rest of the time, nothing happens. The money is the same.
What if the money wasn't for you — it would go entirely to a charity expected to save more than one life?

options.label: Still refuse — I won't cause a death directly
